disclaimer: A portability run measures that the unmodified solver accepts an arbitrary geometry and parameter set deterministically and bounded; the phantom is not any organ's tissue, and nothing here supports a prediction about any cancer other than glioblastoma.

phantom.note: deliberately not make_gbm_phantom and not any organ's tissue; it exists to measure that the solver needs no brain input

bound_note: capacity = K x mask voxels. The model's growth equilibrium is 1.4x capacity (S crowds against only 0.6 of an R at cap), so bounded means <= 2.0x capacity (BOUND_RATIO); the measured max on this phantom is recorded per run, not clipped.

refusals.pitch_says: Metastatic Breast Cancer | Mammary / Fatty Parenchyma Mesh | Automated Ultrasound + DCE-MRI | Paclitaxel / Trastuzumab
refusals.refused_because: 0 mammary meshes, 0 ultrasound/DCE-MRI assets and 0 paclitaxel or trastuzumab parameter sets exist in this tree (live file-path scan of data/), and the tissue diffusion table holds brain classes only.

refusals.pitch_says: you keep 90% of the codebase identical and simply swap out the tissue and drug parameters
refusals.refused_because: The 90% was never measured. What IS measured: the solver's whole tissue/drug surface is 5 dataclasses and 23 fields (introspected live), and 100% of their values in this repository are glioma-derived or explicitly assumed.

refusals.pitch_says: this exact software framework generalizes to predict spatial recurrence and evolutionary resistance in metastatic breast, lung, and pancreatic cancers
refusals.refused_because: Portability is a property of the code: the phantom run shows the unmodified solver executes on arbitrary geometry, but no non-glioma image, mesh, drug parameter set or outcome exists here to calibrate on or test against, so there is no measured breast, lung or pancreatic prediction to report.

refusals.pitch_says: EvoTwin-10X was built precisely to model those invisible residual cells after surgery
refusals.refused_because: No post-operative imaging exists anywhere in this tree (the cached BraTS-2021 cases are pre-operative only), so the post-surgical residual state is not an input this repository has ever had: the clinical intake plants on the pre-operative rim, and stream 1 is REFUSED on its live count of 0 cached captures (claim #49).

refusals.pitch_says: Every cancer type benefits from pulsed or modulated drug scheduling to delay the tipping point of resistant takeover.
refusals.refused_because: Schedule effects in this repository are measured only under the glioma-calibrated clone/drug/immune parameters, on phantoms and committed BraTS-2021 cases. 'Every cancer type' is a universal quantifier over diseases that have no data, mesh or parameter set here.

notes: The phantom is not lung, breast or pancreas tissue -- no such tissue geometry, image or parameter set exists in this repository to build one from; calling it an organ would be mocked.
A run that executes on other geometry says the CODE is generic; it says nothing about whether any equation describes another cancer.
Every value on the swap surface is glioma-derived or explicitly assumed (CALIBRATED / ASSUMED markers are recorded live).
The tissue diffusion table holds brain classes only, and its own docstring marks the values ASSUMED -- no DTI or perfusion series is present in this tree.
No non-glioma outcome exists here to test a prediction against, so cross-cancer accuracy has no denominator.
